zh-CN.title: 修复输入焦点与窗口按钮交互

sections.title: 操作与输入
items: 修复使用鼠标点击执行命令时，“发送命令后输入位置”选择“保持原位”却将焦点留在抽屉的问题
现在点击前位于终端会在发送后回到终端，点击前位于抽屉则继续留在抽屉
恢复按实际窗口控制区避让鼠标命中，消除右上角最小化等按钮的重复悬停提示，同时保持新增分类等弹窗的灰色背景完整显示

zh-CN.notice: 更新后请完整重启 Tabby。现有命令库和插件设置会保留。

en.title: Fix input focus and window control interactions

sections.title: Interaction and input
items: Fix mouse execution leaving focus in the drawer when Input position after sending is set to Keep current position
Focus now returns to the terminal when execution started there, while remaining in the drawer when execution started there
Restore hit testing exclusion based on the actual window controls area to remove duplicate hover hints while preserving the full dialog backdrop

en.notice: Fully restart Tabby after updating. Existing command libraries and plugin settings are preserved.
